question: How does purification through six-path yoga render the ritual object pure?
premises: Purification of the six paths is applied.
This purification is effected through yoga.
The object is thereby made pure.
inference: By performing six-path purification through yoga, that object becomes purified.
uncertainties: The referent of tat is implied from context as the linga.
plain_english: Therefore, having purified that through the yoga of six-path purification, one makes it pure.
